status_effects.explanation: Swann's willingness to be flattered by an undiscerning admirer like Mme Bontemps is presented as a falling-off of his former exactingness.
Being singled out by first name by Mme Verdurin marks Mme Cottard as an enviable insider within the clan's local hierarchy.
The narrator's characterization of her malice and satanic laughter mildly diminishes her in the reader's eyes, independent of the Odette/Verdurin dynamic.

appraisal_events.evidence: toute déchéance acceptée a pour conséquence de rendre les gens moins difficiles ... c'était l'âge aussi où Swann ... se plaisait à entendre dire à Mme Bontemps que c'est ridicule de ne recevoir que des duchesses ... concluant de là ... que c'était une bonne femme, très spirituelle et qui n'était pas snob
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator frames Swann's new taste for Mme Bontemps's flattering, undiscerning company as a symptom of accepted social decline, diminishing the exacting judgment he once had, e.g. at the Verdurins'.

appraisal_events.evidence: On enviait Mme Cottard que la Patronne appelait par son prénom.
appraisal_events.explanation: Mme Cottard is marked as a favored insider of Mme Verdurin's circle, being addressed by her first name, which others present are said to envy.

appraisal_events.evidence: L'oeil brillant de malveillance, de joie et de curiosité ... s'écriait Mme Bontemps en étouffant un rire satanique
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's own descriptors characterize Mme Bontemps as maliciously curious and gleefully spiteful in her salon gossip, casting her in a mildly unflattering light distinct from the Odette/Verdurin movement.
